F-02, F-06 and F-19 from the 2026-09-10 hxm_program report, taken on Anthony's word. Each pinned by a test observed FAILING against the unfixed binary before the fix existed.

Two of the report's items were checked and NOT re-fixed because they had already shipped: F-01 (`suggested_depth` default) and F-11 (ANTICIPATES between proposed brainstorms, exempt since v0.41.0). F-02's own headline — the duplicate guard refusing a capability written after its requirement — was also already fixed on 2026-08-31; only its ergonomics half was built here.
properties.name: Three capture-surface fixes from the hxm_program field report
